amendment: Canonical pair inference before selection and new test scoring
reason: Synthetic duplicate inputs exposed float32 GEMM variation across batch shapes and row positions. Tiny differences can break exact duplicate-caption ties.
canonical_residual: Evaluate each image-text pair at row zero of a one-pair batch, using one Torch CPU thread.
canonical_baseline: Float64 dot product over the original float32-normalized cached features.
training_parameters: Unchanged. Preserve original development outputs and checkpoint receipts.
selection: Recompute development metrics under canonical inference before final selection. Keep recalculated predictions and selections separately.
practical_gate: Unchanged, including 80-comparison adjustment and three nonzero fitted seeds per encoder.
